from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FeeRecord(BaseModel):
    """One entry of a court fee with amount and payer."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The fee amount and unit (e.g., '7300 元')")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee (e.g., '上诉人金某')")
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., '二审案件受理费')")

class MonetaryOrder(BaseModel):
    """One entry of money ordered to be paid/returned between parties."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The monetary amount and unit (e.g., '1534938.4 元')")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who must pay (e.g., '李某 3')")
    payee: str | None = Field(description="Who receives (e.g., '李某 1')")
    action: str | None = Field(description="Nature of payment (e.g., '返还', '赔偿')")

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document sufficient to match to a result."""
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of all involved parties (appellants, respondents, etc.)")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Case number(s) cited in the document")
    court: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court rendering the judgment")
    outcome_type: str | None = Field(description="High-level outcome (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '撤销原判', '再审申请被驳回')")
    fees: list[FeeRecord] = Field(description="Breakdown of court fees and who bears them")
    monetary_orders: list[MonetaryOrder] = Field(description="Specific monetary judgments (amounts, payers, payees)")
    unique_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Any unique identifiers (names, dates, specific terms) found in the text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentRecord] = Field(description="Extracted data from all processed judgment documents")
